problemSolution.title: Stop Juggling Disconnected Tools
problemSolution.description: Traditional school workflows rely on separate quiz tools, manual spreadsheet grading, and end-of-term surprise report cards. School Hub unifies the entire lifecycle.
problemSolution.beforeItem1: Quizzes scattered across Google Forms & loose paper, detached from curriculum standards
problemSolution.beforeItem2: Teachers losing 10+ hours every week manually marking and recalculating test scores
problemSolution.beforeItem3: Parents kept in the dark about academic gaps until final report cards arrive
problemSolution.beforeItem4: Student rosters and class histories wiped out or duplicated when academic years change
problemSolution.afterItem1: Every question is mapped to a structured Subject ➔ Topic ➔ Sub-Topic curriculum taxonomy
problemSolution.afterItem2: Instant automated scoring for MCQs and True/False, plus streamlined grading for short answers
problemSolution.afterItem3: Parents get real-time visibility into assessment results with color-coded health badges
problemSolution.afterItem4: Multi-year continuity preserving historical enrollments and teacher assignments permanently

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Can teachers import questions from existing spreadsheets?
faq.a1: Yes! Teachers can download an official XLSX template with one click, enter questions and options in Excel, and re-upload to instantly populate assessments.
faq.q2: How does auto-grading handle short answers and essays?
faq.a2: Multiple Choice and True/False questions are graded automatically by the engine upon submission. Short answers are presented in an inline manual grading view where teachers can award points and leave constructive feedback.
faq.q3: How are parents connected to their children?
faq.a3: School administrators securely establish Parent-Student links in the Admin Hub. Once linked, parents immediately see their children's assessment timeline and performance averages.
faq.q4: What happens when a new academic year begins?
faq.a4: School Hub uses an immutable enrollment and assignment model. Creating a new Academic Year (e.g. 2026/2027) retains previous historical grades and student records while establishing new class rosters and teacher assignments.
